# P5 checklist — Archive & evolve DoV

| id | Required | Check | Evidence hints |
|----|----------|-------|----------------|
| P5-1 | yes | Living-merge / archive evidence when merge claimed | OpenSpec archive result + KB update evidence per recipe |
| P5-2 | yes | Change summary exists | `/sdd:change-summary` output |
| P5-3 | yes* | G3 decision record when G3 is claimed complete | `g3-decision.md` |
| P5-4 | no | Consistency lint | evidence from `/sdd:consistency-lint`; no evidence / not run → Skipped |
| P5-5 | no | Evolve | evidence from `/sdd:evolve`; no evidence / not run → Skipped |
| P5-6 | no | Followups | evidence from `/sdd:followups`; no evidence / not run → Skipped |

\*If G3 not yet claimed, Skipped.
